scope: Faithfulness and reproducibility of context-informed Leningrad image follow-up reporting, including an explicitly inconclusive Ezekiel letter decision

review_observations.context_informed_fit: The final letter of the target body name has an angular cap more compatible with dalet than the nearby Geshur resh and is comparable to nearby David dalets. This favors the publisher final-dalet follow-up at this source-local locus.

review_observations.canonical_reporting: Actual note a is positioned after Ammihur but explains the later implicit mourner David. The report correctly identifies a separate note-anchor/topic mismatch, not an existing manuscript-name-variant note. No repair is applied or approved here.

review_observations.context_informed_fit: The target initial letter's uneven lower/right contour does not securely distinguish bet from kaf, even with nearby kol and banayikh controls. The report's abstention is warranted.
review_observations.held: No English source choice, original physical damage mechanism, certain repaired bet or certain kaf is inferred. The publisher summary/detail uncertainty remains explicit.

source_and_method_review: Saved API identities, manuscript folio names, full-image URLs and verse ranges agree with the actual images; surrounding text positions the targets. Full-page resized displays were used only for layout, with native crops used for local letter observations.
Private crops are exact decoded-image rectangles. No enhancement, interpolation or generated recovery supplied letter evidence.
An API attribution or linked USC project page does not establish photograph-specific redistribution clearance. Public reuse remains held.
